text:
Every question customers ask you on the phone deserves a blog post.

"Do I need council approval for a patio?"
"How much is a new roof in Perth?"

Answer each one on your website. People type those exact questions into Google.

Write down every question you get this week.

How long should a blog post be?

Google's own guide on helpful content says Google has no preferred word count.

So stop padding a 400-word answer out to 2,000 words.

Answer the customer's question. Then stop.

Air con business in Joondalup. Its winter special ended in June. The page is still up.

Google Ads now copies deals from your website into your ads. It's on by default in a lot of local accounts.

Customer rings asking for the June discount.

Take old specials down this week.
